deviceKey.noKeyStore: This machine has no secure key store — no system keychain is available here. Set a passphrase for this installation to use cloud sync, or leave it off and keep working locally. Everything in Stashpad works offline.
deviceKey.confirmMismatch: The two passphrases do not match
deviceKey.rememberLabel: Remember the passphrase on this machine
deviceKey.rememberWarning: Stashpad will then unlock itself at startup without asking. To do that it has to keep the key on this machine in a form it can read back, so anyone who can read your user account can recover it — another person at your unlocked computer, a backup of this folder, or malware running as you. Leave this off and you will be asked each time the app starts, which is the safer choice.
deviceKey.forgotNote: If you forget it, nothing is lost: this installation sets itself up again and your stashes stay where they are.
deviceKey.wrongPassphrase: That is not the passphrase for this installation
deviceKey.rememberedNotice: Passphrase remembered on this machine — recoverable by anyone with access to your user account.
deviceKey.forgetRemembered: Ask for it again at startup

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.keptInKeychain: This installation's key is kept in your system keychain.
encryption.keptUnderPassphrase: This installation's key is protected by your device passphrase, because no system keychain was usable here.
encryption.keptNowhere: No system keychain and no device passphrase, so nothing is saved on this machine.
encryption.offExplainer: Your stashes are stored on our server so your devices see the same thing. Turn this on and they are encrypted on this machine first, with a key we do not keep.
encryption.costRecovery: You get a recovery code. Lose every installation and that code, and nobody can get your stashes back — not you, and not us.
encryption.costMcp: An access key for AI tools carries its own copy of the key, so our server can read that account while such a request is being served. Create no access key and we cannot read it at all.
encryption.costLocal: This protects what is stored on our server. What is on this computer is unchanged.
encryption.recoveryIntro: Write this down now, or put it in your password manager. It is shown once and cannot be shown again.
encryption.recoveryWarning: If you lose every installation and this code, your stashes cannot be recovered — not by you, and not by us. There is no exception we could make.
encryption.typeBackLabel: Type the last group ({group}) to confirm you have it
encryption.typeBackMismatch: That is not the last group of the code. Check what you wrote down.
encryption.converting: Encrypting your stashes. {count} still to go — you can keep working, and it carries on where it left off if you close the app.
encryption.convertingDone: Everything is encrypted. Finish to seal the account.
encryption.finishBlocked: Available once every stash has been encrypted.
encryption.sealedExplainer: Your stashes are encrypted before they leave this machine.
encryption.lockedHere: This installation does not have the key yet. Approve it from an installation that does, or enter your recovery code.
encryption.compareInstruction: Check this matches what the other installation shows. If it does not, do not approve it.
